item.title: Hobe Sound gets first Aldi grocery store opening July 9 at former Winn-Dixie site
item.description: Hobe Sound is getting its first Aldi store, opening Wednesday at 8867 SE Bridge Road in the space where Winn-Dixie used to be.

item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: The 44-year-old tennis star pulled out of her doubles match after draining fluid from her right knee following a three-set singles loss earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina survives 3-2 thriller against Cape Verde to advance in World Cup
item.description: Lionel Messi scored his 20th career World Cup goal as Argentina narrowly defeated Cape Verde 3-2 in extra time in South Florida.

item.title: FIFA lifts Folarin Balogun suspension after Trump calls FIFA president
item.description: President Donald Trump intervened on behalf of the American striker, whose red-card suspension was lifted ahead of Monday's World Cup match against Belgium.

item.title: Belgium federation outraged after FIFA lifts Balogun suspension following Trump call
item.description: The Royal Belgian Football Association said it is investigating options after FIFA lifted the American striker's suspension in what appears to be the first time since 1962 a World Cup red card did not result in a suspension.
